arStrings.szText: {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} also forms a seismic line that deals its damage and Slows enemies hit by {c:FF44A68E}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. {c_important}Earthquakes{/c} it passes through explode for their total damage and are consumed.
